name: dsh-sidebar-default-collapsed
description: Local persistent Web UI patch: the left sidebar starts collapsed on every page load (upstream hardcodes its initial preference to 280px and exposes no config / no persistence). Boot-time, one-shot: on a frame at or above upstream's 1024px auto-collapse breakpoint the plugin reads the live layout store (slots.entries('root') → resolveStore) and calls ctx.layout.toggleSidebar() once; narrow frames need nothing (upstream is already collapsed there, and toggling would expand). TypeScript: host half index.ts (type stripping), browser half src/client.ts → lib/client.js (esbuild).
